_doc: PICO-level adjudication of the topic-side firewall flags. The token screen is a cheap over-inclusive filter; this file is the judgement it hands off to. One decision per comparator-vs-scored-topic collision, written as DATA. No number is touched by it: the only effect is whether a comparator may seed a topic.
_adjudicator: claude-opus-5, in-session, reading comparator title + flagged scored-topic keys

_scale.COLLISION: the comparator's PICO overlaps a scored topic's PICO. It may NOT seed that topic. Firewall holds.
_scale.REVIEW: intervention family or population overlaps but the question differs. Treated as BLOCKED (fail closed) until adjudicated per trial.
_scale.NO_COLLISION: the flag is an artefact of a generic shared token; the subject matter does not overlap.

_screen_performance.note: Precision 8/22. Recall of the pre-fix screen was 3/5. A screen that over-flags on a generic token while under-flagging the exact collision is not failing closed; it has a hole.
